title: A handler with a cache hands its worker the calling agent's own last three completed tasks of the room, newest first, each once, quoted and bounded, after what the model passed; another agent's and another room's stay out, and all of them when an intelligence channel is shared, which reads the description, while what the call passed stays; the task's metadata keeps them under previous_tasks; a string context beside them is no failure
notes: Python: tests/tasks/test_cache.py::TestDelegateHandlerWithCache::test_the_worker_s_model_reads_the_previous_tasks; tasks/delegate.py DelegateHandler, tasks/cache.py, tasks/brief.py previous_tasks_block. Each task is bounded at 600 characters, as a message of the conversation is, and written as json_text_line writes it. An agent hands over its own tasks only (HITL 673c8148): another agent's may quote what it may not read. Python's public recent_context still lists the room's, what a host reads. A shared intelligence channel stops them as it stops the conversation, what the framework rebuilds (§7.5 rule 8); the context stays, the model's own text of this call, as the task is.
